text: as the 20th century drew to a close humanity seemed to have won the cold war was over the threat of nuclear apocalypse had receded the western world was entering an era of unprecedented economic prosperity and technological progress history with its global catastrophes and world wars seemed to have reached a happy ending in new york the world trade center stood as a symbol of this new interconnected world two enormous towers piercing the sky 50 000 people worked there every day the towers were a vital part of the global economy monuments to engineering and to an unshakable faith in the future no one imagined that the sophisticated systems that kept the modern world running would be turned against it the threat wasn't coming from outer space it was taking shape in human minds far from the gleaming cities in places where time seemed to stand still 10 years before the attacks it's 1991 the world is celebrating the end of the cold war the soviet union is in its final months the berlin wall has fallen western democracy appears to have won history's final battle the united states stands alone as the world's undisputed superpower in the deserts of the middle east american forces crush the iraqi military in a matter of weeks during operation desert storm demonstrating overwhelming military and technological superiority u.s military bases establish a lasting foothold on the arabian peninsula at the heart of the islamic world this new order seems unassailable but thousands of miles from wall street in the mountains of afghanistan and the deserts of the middle east another force is emerging its strength lies in an ideology fueled by fanaticism and historical grievances rather than tanks or aircraft carriers a small group of men hardened by guerrilla warfare decides to bring the battlefield to an enemy that seems beyond its reach a deadly course has been set for now it exists only as an idea turn commercial aviation one of the western world's proudest achievements into a weapon of impact in the caves of afghanistan and the training camps of sudan the terrorist organization al-qaeda begins taking shape under osama bin laden the idea of striking at america's heart destroying the symbols of its power is already in the air the tragedy is still 10 long years away but the seeds of hatred have been planted one year before the attacks the new century has arrived the dreaded y2k disaster never materialized america is enjoying an unprecedented economic boom internet companies are springing up everywhere people are investing planning vacations buying homes feeling safe is something they take for granted but the men who will bring tragedy to the country are already here they live openly in ordinary american suburbs they eat burgers work out at gyms go shopping mohammed atta marwan al-shehi and ziyad jarrah are young educated men they have come to the united states with one specific purpose in september 2000 they are in florida learning to fly commercial airliners their instructors find one thing a little strange these students have no interest in learning how to take off or land all they want to know is how to control a plane once it's airborne how to steer and maneuver at cruising speed but in a free country nobody asks too many questions of a paying customer meanwhile inside the intelligence agencies warning lights are flashing cia director george tenet will later describe a system practically screaming that something terrible is coming intercepted conversations and reports from agents all point to al-qaeda preparing something enormous an attack on an almost unimaginable scale intelligence agencies pick up fragments of conversations a big wedding is coming there will be a celebration soon but bureaucracy the failure of the fbi and cia to share information and a simple human inability to imagine the unthinkable keep anyone from putting the pieces together one month before the attacks it's a hot stifling summer president george w bush is on vacation at his ranch in crawford texas on august 6 2001 the president's daily brief lands on his desk a classified intelligence report drawing on the work of the nation's intelligence agencies one item carries this title bin laden determined to strike in u.s the report mentions suspicious individuals connected to bin laden and the possibility of aircraft hijackings but its language is broad there are no dates no targets no names by early september the terrorists are making their final preparations and booking their flights they deliberately buy 19 one-way tickets on morning transcontinental flights operated by american airlines and united airlines they choose seats exclusively in first and business class giving them the shortest possible route to the cockpit doors the flights depart from boston newark and washington bound for los angeles and san francisco these routes are chosen for a reason planes flying across the country carry full fuel loads tens of thousands of gallons of jet fuel for a few thousand dollars the terrorists have legally gained access to what they intend to turn into four massive guided incendiary weapons in august the fbi arrests zacharias moussaoui in minnesota another flight student whose behavior has alarmed his instructors his computer is seized but legal obstacles prevent agents from obtaining a warrant to search it immediately 24 hours before the attacks a thunderstorm is moving over the east coast rain pours down on new york thunder rolls overhead it's an otherwise ordinary evening in early fall people come home from work eat dinner at restaurants watch evening tv put their children to bed millions of americans set their alarms for tuesday morning lay out their clothes and check tomorrow's appointments mohammed atta and abdulaziz alomari two of the 19 hijackers spend the evening in portland maine they eat at a cheap pizza place stop at an atm and shop at a local walmart security footage later seen around the world shows them looking completely calm no hesitation no visible nerves they know they have less than 24 hours to live that same evening at the pentagon defense secretary donald rumsfeld gives a speech warning that the department's own bureaucracy threatens national security with accounting systems that cannot track trillions of dollars in new york world trade center security guards make their evening rounds one hour before the attacks the overnight storm has cleared the air september 11 dawns with extraordinary clarity above new york and the east coast the sky is a brilliant cloudless blue pilots have a name for weather like this severe clear perfect flying weather 7 45 a.m at airports in boston newark and washington thousands of people are going through security in 2001 it's routine no body scanners no taking off your shoes liquids and small knives are allowed the terrorists walk through metal detectors some have box cutters hidden in their carry-on bags under the security rules of the time these items are permitted passengers settle into their seats the 19 terrorists are spread across four planes flights 11 175 77 and 93 they take seats in business class and the front rows of coach close to the cockpits at the world trade center the workday is already underway high-speed elevators carry thousands of people up to their offices the attacks at 8 14 a.m air traffic controllers lose contact with american airlines flight 11. the plane makes a sharp change of course inside terrorists armed with box cutters have killed the pilots and flight attendants sprayed tear gas forced passengers to the back of the plane and locked themselves inside the cockpit mohammed ata is at the controls at 8 46 a.m manhattan shutters a massive boeing airliner traveling at more than 435 miles per hour slams into the world trade center's north tower between the 93rd and 99th floors at first no one understands what has happened morning news anchors interrupt their broadcasts we're getting reports that a plane has crashed into the world trade center around the world millions assume it must be a terrible navigational error thick black smoke pours from the gaping wound in the north tower every camera in new york seems to be trained on it hundreds of people inside the tower die instantly those above the impact zone are trapped every stairway has been destroyed every route down is cut off temperatures from the burning jet fuel reach roughly 1800 degrees fahrenheit in the south tower people stare in horror at the burning building next door an announcement comes over the pa system please remain at your desks the south tower is secure many obey then at 903 a.m a second boeing airliner flight 175 banks smoothly and tears into the south tower at tremendous speed millions watch it happen on live television a fireball erupts from the other side of the building in that instant the world changes forever any hope that this was an accident disappears everyone understands america is under attack chaos spreads across the country at 9 37 a.m a third plane flight 77 crashes into the pentagon's western side the headquarters of the u.s military the most heavily protected building on the planet is burning an order goes out to shut down u.s airspace immediately thousands of planes are directed to land at the nearest airports at 9 59 a.m the south tower begins to collapse it has stood for just 56 minutes since the impact its steel frame can no longer withstand the extreme heat of the burning fuel 110 stories of glass concrete and steel fold like a house of cards in 10 seconds a tidal wave of ash and debris engulfs lower manhattan meanwhile aboard the fourth plane flight 93 passengers learn through cell phone calls what is happening in new york they realize their plane too is being used as a bomb headed for the capital or the white house they make the heroic decision to storm the cockpit at 10 03 a.m as the struggle unfolds the hijackers drive the plane into the ground it crashes in a field in pennsylvania no one survives but their actions likely save many lives at 10 28 a.m the north tower falls the landmarks that defined new york's skyline are gone in 102 minutes 2977 people have been killed one hour after the attacks 11 30 a.m new york looks as though it has been hit by a nuclear blast lower manhattan is dark in the middle of the day the dust is so thick that people can barely breathe it stings their eyes and coats their bodies in a ghostly gray powder survivors stumble through the streets in shock moving like zombies for the first time in aviation history the skies over the united states are empty of civilian traffic only military fighter jets remain with orders to shoot down any civilian aircraft that fails to respond the country is paralyzed government officials have been evacuated to bunkers rumors spread of more attacks in other cities around the world people sit frozen in front of their televisions overwhelmed by horror no one knows whether the nightmare is over or whether it has only begun 24 hours after the attacks smoke is still rising into the sky rescue workers firefighters police officers and volunteers dig through the rubble with their bare hands hoping to find survivors beneath the mountains of twisted steel many of them will soon develop serious cancers after exposure to the toxic dust and smoke thousands of flyers begin appearing across new york families whose loved ones went to work in the towers and never came home print their photographs and put them up on walls around the world an unprecedented wave of solidarity takes hold the french newspaper le monde carries the headline today we are all americans even some of america's fiercest enemies offer condolences but within the united states grief is giving way to a quiet searing rage intelligence agencies have already confirmed who is responsible osama bin laden and al-qaeda sheltering in afghanistan under taliban protection the machinery of war begins to turn one month after the attacks october 2001 the ruins of the world trade center are still smoldering it will take more than three months to put out the fires america has changed beyond recognition operation enduring freedom has begun american and british aircraft are bombing taliban camps and infrastructure in afghanistan the longest war in american history is underway congress passes the patriot act giving intelligence agencies unlimited powers to monitor citizens tap phones and read private communications without court approval america willingly gives up some of its freedom in exchange for security airports introduce strict screening procedures and new restrictions the age of trust is over an age of total surveillance has begun one year after the attacks on september 11th 2002 the first anniversary memorial ceremony takes place at the site of the tragedy ground zero is now an enormous excavation cleared of millions of tons of debris the names of all 2977 victims are read aloud the reading lasts for hours apart from the names there is the missing person flyers have long since faded soaked through in the rain and been taken down hope has given way to acceptance and remembrance two powerful beams rise into the new york sky the tribute in light traces the outlines of the fallen twin towers they pierce the darkness like ghosts of the past meanwhile tensions around the world continue to rise american troops occupy afghanistan bin laden is in hiding but the bush administration is already turning toward a new target iraq the tragedy of 9-11 has become a justification for redrawing the geopolitical map of the middle east 25 years after the attacks a quarter of a century has passed 25 years a moment in history an entire era in a human life by 2011 the war on terror had become a series of grinding exhausting conflicts in the middle east iraq was devastated afghanistan remained unstable that may u.s navy seals killed osama bin laden at his hideout in pakistan today one world trade center rises above the rebuilt site in new york its height is symbolic 1776 feet honoring the year the declaration of independence was adopted nearby two enormous memorial pools occupy the footprints of the original towers water flows endlessly down their dark walls and disappears into the depths along their edges inscribed in bronze are the names of those who never came home that clear september morning an entire generation has grown up since the attacks for today's 20 year olds september 11th is a chapter in a history textbook they never knew the world before it long airport lines metal detectors global surveillance and the constant threat of terrorism are simply normal to them the background of everyday life the war in afghanistan ended in a painful chaotic withdrawal osama bin laden has been dead for years but the consequences of that day are still with us hundreds of rescue workers firefighters and police officers who breathe the toxic dust at ground zero have died or are still dying from rare cancers and respiratory diseases their sacrifice did not end on september 11. it has stretched across decades that morning in 2001 divided the world into before and after we are still living in the world that emerged from the ashes of the twin towers and this story reminds us just how fragile that world can be
